quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #18
										  					
  

50 Questions • Passing Score 40

questions.question: What do work zone signs mean?

options.text: You must stop immediately and back up.
You should drive faster to leave the work zone.

questions.explanation: Work zone signs are orange. They warn that construction or road work is happening on or near the road. Drive carefully when you see these signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people walking into the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: You must stop at an intersection when you see:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop, look both ways, and only go when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light?
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light warns of danger ahead. Slow down and proceed carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on a yellow background. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What do speed limit signs show?

options.text: The suggested speed for the area.
The fastest and slowest legal speeds allowed.
The speed to drive in heavy traffic.
The speed to drive in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: The fastest and slowest legal speeds allowed.
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs show the highest and lowest speeds you are allowed to drive. These limits are for good driving conditions. You must drive slower when conditions are bad.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic on the road only goes one way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: If another car is about to hit you, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn other drivers or pedestrians who may not see you. If you think another car is about to hit you, sound your horn.

questions.question: What color are road markings that separate traffic going in opposite directions?
questions.explanation: Yellow lines in the center of the road separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: Is it illegal to drive at night using only parking lights?
questions.explanation: You cannot drive at night using only parking lights. You must use your headlights when driving in the dark.

questions.question: Roads freeze quickly when they are:
questions.explanation: Shaded areas under trees or buildings freeze before the rest of the road. They also dry last. Be extra careful on these sections in cold or wet weather.

questions.question: Drowsy drivers:

options.text: Should drink strong black coffee to stay awake.
Can drive so poorly that they may appear to be drunk.
Can stay alert by opening a window and turning up the radio.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can drive so poorly that they may appear to be drunk.
questions.explanation: Drowsy drivers can drive as poorly as drunk drivers. Opening a window, turning up the radio, or drinking coffee is not enough to keep a drowsy driver alert and safe.

questions.question: When you see other drivers acting angry around you:
questions.explanation: When other drivers are angry, stay away from them. Avoid eye contact and hand gestures. Slow down, move over, or do whatever you safely can to get away from danger.

questions.question: A stop sign is shaped like a(n):
questions.explanation: Only stop signs are octagonal (eight-sided). This shape tells drivers to come to a complete stop before going forward.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic signal means a ____ light will soon appear.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light warns you that a red light is coming next.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: Road rage and aggressive driving can be reduced by:
questions.explanation: To help prevent road rage, allow plenty of travel time, obey speed limits, and use your turn signals. These actions help reduce conflicts on busy roads.

questions.question: You may drive across a dashed white line:

options.text: When it is safe to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is safe to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Dashed white lines separate lanes going the same direction. You may cross them to pass or change lanes if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What kinds of drugs can affect your driving ability?
questions.explanation: Many drugs can affect your driving. This includes illegal drugs and legal over-the-counter or prescription medicines. Driving while impaired by any drug is illegal.

questions.question: When may you proceed through an intersection with a stop sign but no stop line or crosswalk?

options.text: After slowing down to verify that there is no cross traffic
After coming to a complete stop and verifying that it is safe to proceed
After you have stopped at least 20 feet prior to the intersection
After slowing down to a speed of 10 mph

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and verifying that it is safe to proceed
questions.explanation: At a stop sign with no stop line or crosswalk, come to a complete stop before entering the intersection. Then proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: It is okay for drivers to follow motorcycles closely.
A motorcycle with two riders is more balanced than one with just the rider.
When passing a motorcycle, you must move completely into the other lane.
You can expect a motorcycle's brake lights to turn on when it slows down.

questions.correctAnswerText: When passing a motorcycle, you must move completely into the other lane.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have the right to use a full lane. Before passing a motorcycle on the left, make sure your entire vehicle is in the left lane.

questions.question: A solid yellow line on your side of the centerline means:
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line next to your lane means you cannot pass from your direction.

questions.question: Night driving requires more caution because:

options.text: There is more traffic at night.
Drivers cannot see as well at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers cannot see as well at night.
questions.explanation: It is dark at night, so drivers cannot see as well as they do during the day. From 30 minutes after sunset until 30 minutes before sunrise, or any time vehicles cannot be seen 500 feet away, you must use your headlights.

questions.question: What does an orange sign indicate?

options.text: The start of a no passing zone.

questions.explanation: Orange signs with black symbols warn of construction, maintenance, or emergency work.

questions.question: When you see a railroad crossing warning sign:

options.text: Be ready to drive faster than the train.
Be ready to stop if a train is near.
Look for a way around lowered gates.
Assume no trains are near and drive normally.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if a train is near.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossing warning signs alert drivers that a train may be coming. Always obey these signs and never go around barriers.

questions.question: A red flashing traffic light means the same as:
questions.explanation: A red flashing traffic light means the same as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: When someone is tailgating you:

options.text: Move right if there is an open lane available.
If no right lane exists, wait until the road ahead is clear, then slowly reduce your speed to let them pass.

questions.explanation: If being tailgated and a right lane is available, move right. If not, wait until ahead is clear and slow down gradually. This lets the tailgater pass. Never brake suddenly, as this increases the risk of being hit from behind.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for any vehicles or pedestrians to pass before continuing.

questions.question: Never drive through, around, or under railroad gates or barriers.
questions.explanation: Never drive through, around, or under railroad gates or barriers. It is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: The most important thing about speed and curves is:

options.text: Drive at the speed limit as you enter the curve, then slow down at the sharpest part.
Slow down before you enter the curve.
Speed up gently before you enter the curve.
Drive at the speed limit before, during, and after the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before you enter the curve.
questions.explanation: Slow down before entering a curve. Your vehicle's weight may make it hard to turn at high speeds. Slowing down before the curve helps you stay in control.

questions.question: What should you do at a yield sign?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: You can pass another vehicle if the line between lanes is a ____ line.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic going in the same direction. You can cross broken white lines to pass if the other lane is clear.

questions.question: If traffic lights stop working at an intersection, what should you do?

options.text: Park off the road and wait for power to return.
Use hand signals to show other drivers what you will do.
Turn on hazard lights and drive through without stopping.
Treat it like a four-way stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a four-way stop.
questions.explanation: When a traffic light is not working, treat the intersection like a four-way stop. Yield to other drivers as you would at a four-way stop, then go through carefully when it is your turn.

questions.question: While waiting in an intersection to turn left, what should you do?

options.text: Signal and turn your wheels to the left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights so drivers will let you through.
Drive around a car that is blocking you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn left. If a car hits you from behind, straight wheels keep you from being pushed into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: At a light rail intersection, you must always:

options.text: Look both ways before crossing tracks.
Pay attention and follow all traffic signals.
Share the road with pedestrians and bicyclists.

questions.explanation: Never drive around lowered crossing gates. Always look both ways before crossing train tracks. Always obey signs and traffic signals. Trains share the road with cars and bicyclists.

questions.question: Can you cross a double solid yellow centerline to pass another car?

options.text: Yes, if there is no oncoming traffic.
Yes, if the car ahead is going under the speed limit.

questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no one can cross them, except when turning into a driveway or business entrance. Passing over a solid yellow line is never allowed.

questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights, you must:

options.text: Slow down and stay in your lane.
Pull to the right and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights or hear a siren, pull to the right side of the road immediately and stop.

questions.question: When a driver is turning and a pedestrian is crossing with no traffic light, who must yield?
questions.explanation: Drivers must yield to pedestrians crossing at any intersection, even without a traffic light or crosswalk.

questions.question: When a driver behind you wants to pass, you should:

options.text: Slow down to give them room to pass safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to give them room to pass safely.
questions.explanation: When another driver wants to pass you, slow down so they have enough room in front of your vehicle to complete the pass safely and quickly.

questions.question: You must be careful near a pedestrian with a white cane because:
questions.explanation: A white cane means the pedestrian is blind. Slow down, yield the right-of-way, and be ready to stop to avoid hitting them.

questions.question: How can you avoid making emergency stops while driving in traffic?

options.text: Honk your horn to alert other drivers.
Look ahead and keep a safe distance from the car in front of you.
Drive only in the right lane.
Drive slower than the traffic around you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look ahead and keep a safe distance from the car in front of you.
questions.explanation: A safe following distance gives you time to react to problems ahead. This helps you avoid sudden stops that could cause the car behind you to crash into you.

questions.question: At a stop sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for cars following too closely.
Move when the car ahead of you moves.
Look right, then left, then right again.
Look left, then right, then left again.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look left, then right, then left again.
questions.explanation: Look left first because cars from the left are closer to you. Then look right. Finally, look left again to check for any cars you may have missed.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching a railroad crossing without traffic signals?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals, so this never happens.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Slow down and check both directions for trains. If you see or hear a train, stop at a safe distance from the tracks. Wait until the train passes before crossing.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic light, you must:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Let traffic and pedestrians pass. Go only when it is safe. At railroad crossings, a flashing red light means a train is coming. Wait until the lights stop flashing before you go.

questions.question: A driver turning left must yield to a bicyclist coming from the opposite direction.
questions.explanation: When turning left, you must yield to bicycles coming toward you, just as you would for cars. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn. Go when it is safe.

questions.question: Defensive driving means:

options.text: Using safe driving habits to prevent crashes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Using safe driving habits to prevent crashes.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means using safe strategies to prevent crashes. Adjust your driving for weather, how you feel, and the actions of other drivers, bicyclists, and pedestrians.

questions.question: You can always make U-turns in school zones.
questions.explanation: Nevada law does not allow U-turns in school zones unless there are no children present, school is not in session, or signs show that school zone rules do not apply.

questions.question: When approaching an intersection with no traffic control signs, a driver should:

options.text: Keep going at the same speed.
Stop, look all directions, and go.

questions.explanation: At an intersection with no stop sign or signal, yield to vehicles coming from your right. Always be ready to yield to avoid a crash. Slow down, be ready to brake, and look left, right, and left again.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: When changing lanes on a highway, you should:

options.text: Check your rearview and side mirrors.
Check your blind spot by looking over your shoulder.

questions.explanation: When changing lanes, signal first. Check your mirrors and look over your shoulder to check your blind spot before moving.
